titleEn: Survival craft, launching appliances and on-load release gear — weekly visual inspection
titleTr: Can kurtarma araçları, indirme donanımları ve yük altında bırakma donanımı — haftalık gözle muayene
descriptionEn: Visually inspect all survival craft, rescue boats, launching appliances and on-load release gear to confirm they are ready for use. Record the inspection in the log book.

flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: life-saving equipment is covered by Marine Notice SAF-001.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: records may be kept on paper or computer-based on board (MMC-281).

titleEn: Lifeboat engine — weekly run
titleTr: Can filikası motoru — haftalık çalıştırma
descriptionEn: Start and run the lifeboat and rescue boat engines. Record the run and any defect in the log book.

flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: records may be kept on paper or computer-based on board (MMC-281).

titleEn: General emergency alarm — weekly test
titleTr: Genel acil durum alarmı — haftalık test
descriptionEn: Test the general emergency alarm system and record the test in the log book.

titleEn: Lifeboats moved from the stowed position — monthly
titleTr: Can filikalarının istif konumundan çıkarılması — aylık
descriptionEn: Move each lifeboat from its stowed position, without any person on board, so far as is necessary to demonstrate satisfactory operation — unless weather conditions prevent it, in which case record the reason.

flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: records may be kept on paper or computer-based on board (MMC-281).

titleEn: LSA inspection using the maintenance checklist — monthly
titleTr: Bakım kontrol listesi ile can kurtarma teçhizatı muayenesi — aylık
descriptionEn: Inspect all life-saving appliances, including lifeboat equipment, using the checklist from the onboard maintenance instructions, and confirm they are complete and in good order. Report the inspection in the log book.

flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: life-saving equipment is covered by Marine Notice SAF-001.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: records may be kept on paper or computer-based on board (MMC-281).

titleEn: Portable fire extinguisher — monthly visual check
titleTr: Portatif yangın söndürücü — aylık gözle kontrol
descriptionEn: Monthly visual check of every portable extinguisher: it is in its designated position, access is unobstructed, the operating instructions are legible, the safety pin and seal are intact, the pressure gauge (where fitted) reads in the operating range, the bracket is secure and there is no visible corrosion or damage.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: Fire detector and manual call point — monthly sample test
titleTr: Yangın dedektörü ve ihbar butonu — aylık numune testi
descriptionEn: Test a sample of the fire detectors and manual call points and confirm correct indication and alarm at the panel. Record which loop/zone was tested so that the whole installation is covered over time.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: SCBA cylinder pressure — weekly check
titleTr: SCBA tüp basıncı — haftalık kontrol
descriptionEn: Check and record the cylinder pressure of every breathing apparatus set and spare cylinder. Recharge any set below the pressure stated in the maker's manual.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: SCBA — monthly officer's check
titleTr: SCBA — aylık zabit kontrolü
descriptionEn: The responsible officer verifies the weekly cylinder pressure records and inspects the sets: face mask, harness, demand valve, low-pressure warning whistle and spare cylinders. Recorded as the officer's check referred to in the weekly requirement.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: Portable fire extinguisher — annual service
titleTr: Portatif yangın söndürücü — yıllık servis
descriptionEn: Annual service at intervals not exceeding 12 months by a competent person. The service label must show the date and the identity of the person or company that carried it out. Whether trained ship's crew may perform this service is flag-dependent.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: annual extinguisher servicing may be carried out by trained ship's crew (competence per STCW A-VI/3) as an alternative to a shore facility (Marine Notice FIR-001).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: Lifeboat, rescue boat, launching appliance and release gear — annual thorough examination and operational test
titleTr: Can filikası, kurtarma botu, indirme donanımı ve bırakma donanımı — yıllık detaylı muayene ve fonksiyon testi
descriptionEn: Annual thorough examination and operational test of the survival craft, its launching appliance and its on-load release gear, at intervals of 12 months with the HSSC harmonised window of ±3 months. Carried out by an authorised service provider or the manufacturer, authorised for that make and type.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: service/inspection reports to be countersigned by the Company representative or the Master (Marine Notice 2-011-37).
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: use a provider from the Administration's published list of authorised lifeboat service providers (Marine Notice SAF-005).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: a ±3-month window applies to annual LSA performance tests (MMC-281). Panama: authorised service providers for lifeboats, rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear are governed by MMC-258.

titleEn: Inflatable liferaft — annual servicing
titleTr: Şişme can salı — yıllık servis
descriptionEn: Servicing at an approved servicing station at intervals of 12 months, with the HSSC harmonised window of ±3 months. In special cases the Administration may extend the interval to 17 months by dispensation.

flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: liferaft servicing may be extended to 17 months by dispensation (Marine Notice SAF-001).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: extensions up to 17 months are provided for certain inflatable equipment with Administration authorisation (MMC-281).

titleEn: Hydrostatic release unit — replacement or servicing
titleTr: Hidrostatik bırakma ünitesi — değişim veya servis
descriptionEn: Disposable hydrostatic release units are replaced at intervals of 24 months; serviceable units are serviced at an approved station or at the interval stated by the maker. Always read the unit's own marked expiry.

flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: life-saving equipment is covered by Marine Notice SAF-001.

titleEn: Inflatable lifejacket — annual service
titleTr: Şişme can yeleği — yıllık servis
descriptionEn: Inflatable lifejackets are serviced at intervals of 12 months at an approved servicing station, or by trained crew where the flag Administration permits it. The service covers the inflation cylinder, the automatic head and the gas-tightness of the bladder.

flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: lifejackets are covered by Marine Notice SAF-006.

titleEn: Immersion suit — air-pressure test
titleTr: Dalma giysisi — hava basınç testi
descriptionEn: Air-pressure test of immersion suits at intervals of 3 years for suits less than 10 years old, in accordance with MSC/Circ.1047 and MSC/Circ.1114. For older suits follow the flag Administration's notice and the maker's instructions.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: immersion suits less than 10 years old are to be tested at intervals not exceeding 3 years (Marine Notice 2-011-37).
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: immersion suits and thermal protective aids are covered by Marine Notice SAF-007.

titleEn: Fixed gas fire-extinguishing system — content check
titleTr: Sabit gazlı söndürme sistemi — muhteva (dolum) kontrolü
descriptionEn: Check the content of the fixed gas fire-extinguishing system at intervals of 2 years, by weighing or by an approved level-indication method, and record the result cylinder by cylinder.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: fixed-gas cylinders are to hold not less than 95% of the nominal charge (Marine Notice 2-011-14).
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: fixed CO2 cylinders are to hold not less than 90% of the nominal charge (Marine Notice FIR-001).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: Fire extinguisher — five-yearly test discharge
titleTr: Yangın söndürücü — beş yıllık test boşaltımı
descriptionEn: At intervals of 5 years, at least one extinguisher of each type manufactured in the same year is discharged as a test, at a service facility.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: Fire detectors — five-yearly test of all detectors
titleTr: Yangın dedektörleri — beş yılda bir tüm dedektörlerin testi
descriptionEn: All fire detectors are tested at intervals of 5 years by a service facility, using equipment producing hot air, smoke or aerosol as appropriate to the detector type.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: SCBA / EEBD cylinder — five-yearly hydrostatic test
titleTr: SCBA / EEBD tüpü — beş yıllık hidrostatik test
descriptionEn: Breathing-apparatus and EEBD cylinders are hydrostatically tested at intervals of 5 years at a certified facility. The test date is stamped on the cylinder.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: On-load release gear — five-yearly overload operational test at 1.1 × fully-loaded mass
titleTr: Yük altında bırakma donanımı — beş yıllık 1,1 × tam yüklü kütle ile aşırı yük testi
descriptionEn: At intervals of 5 years the on-load release gear is overhauled and subjected to an overload operational test at 1.1 times the fully-loaded mass of the survival craft, by an authorised provider.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: the five-yearly overload test and overhaul is to be carried out with an RO surveyor in attendance (Marine Notice 2-011-37).
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: use a provider from the Administration's published list of authorised lifeboat service providers (Marine Notice SAF-005).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: authorised service providers for lifeboats, rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear are governed by MMC-258.

titleEn: Winch brake — five-yearly dynamic test
titleTr: Vinç freni — beş yıllık dinamik test
descriptionEn: The launching appliance winch brake is subjected to a dynamic test at intervals of 5 years, by an authorised provider, in accordance with MSC.402(96).

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: service/inspection reports to be countersigned by the Company representative or the Master (Marine Notice 2-011-37).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: authorised service providers for lifeboats, rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear are governed by MMC-258.

titleEn: Falls — turned end-for-end or renewed
titleTr: Fals telleri — baş-kıç değiştirme veya yenileme
descriptionEn: Falls used in launching are turned end-for-end and renewed at the intervals required by SOLAS III/20 and the maker's instructions. This app does not assert those intervals — read them from the current text of SOLAS III/20 and from the maker's manual, and enter the resulting date.
evidenceRequired: Service report where a provider is used

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: bulldog grips are not accepted on load-bearing wire terminations (Marine Notice 2-011-37).

titleEn: Fire extinguisher — ten-yearly hydrostatic test
titleTr: Yangın söndürücü — on yıllık hidrostatik test
descriptionEn: Extinguisher bodies are hydrostatically tested at intervals of 10 years by a facility certified by a government agency or a recognised organisation.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: the ten-yearly hydrostatic test is to be done by a facility certified by a government agency or an RO (Marine Notice 2-011-14).
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: Fixed system flexible hoses — ten-yearly replacement
titleTr: Sabit sistem esnek hortumları — on yılda bir değişim
descriptionEn: Flexible hoses in fixed fire-extinguishing systems are replaced at intervals of 10 years, or earlier if the maker requires it.

flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: external technicians must provide an inspection report on completion; provider certificates are valid 3 years (MMC-281).

titleEn: CO2 cylinders — hydrostatic test sampling
titleTr: CO2 tüpleri — hidrostatik test numunelemesi
descriptionEn: Hydrostatic testing of CO2 cylinders is done on a sampling basis: 10% of the bank at 10 years, escalating to 100% at 20 years. Record which cylinders were tested at each sampling so the escalation can be evidenced.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: fixed-gas cylinders are to hold not less than 95% of the nominal charge (Marine Notice 2-011-14).
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: fixed CO2 cylinders are to hold not less than 90% of the nominal charge (Marine Notice FIR-001).

titleEn: Pyrotechnics — renewal at the marked expiry
titleTr: Piroteknikler — üzerinde yazılı son kullanma tarihinde yenileme
descriptionEn: Pyrotechnic signals are renewed at the expiry date marked by the maker. Read the date from the item itself and enter it — do not assume a standard shelf life.
evidenceRequired: Landing receipt for the expired stock

titleEn: EPIRB — annual performance test, battery and hydrostatic release
titleTr: EPIRB — yıllık performans testi, batarya ve hidrostatik bırakma
descriptionEn: The EPIRB is subject to an annual performance test. The battery and the hydrostatic release unit are renewed at the intervals stated by the maker and marked on the unit.

titleEn: CO2 extinguisher — cylinder weight check
titleTr: CO2 söndürücü — tüp ağırlık kontrolü
descriptionEn: Weigh the CO2 extinguisher and compare against the tare and charged weights stamped on the body; recharge if the loss exceeds the maker's limit. Applies when the extinguishing medium is CO2. This app does not assert an interval for this check — take it from the maker's manual and from the vessel's maintenance plan under SOLAS II-2/14, and record it here.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: Dry powder extinguisher — powder condition / caking check
titleTr: Kuru kimyevi tozlu söndürücü — toz durumu / kekleşme kontrolü
descriptionEn: Check the dry powder charge for caking and free flow, and check the propellant cartridge where fitted. Applies when the extinguishing medium is a dry powder. This app does not assert an interval for this check — take it from the maker's manual and from the vessel's maintenance plan under SOLAS II-2/14, and record it here.
evidenceRequired: Service report where opened by a provider

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are performed by the crew (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which require specially trained persons (MMC-281).

titleEn: Routine check under the onboard maintenance plan
titleTr: Gemi bakım planına göre rutin kontrol
descriptionEn: Routine inspection and testing of this item under the vessel's onboard maintenance plan required by SOLAS II-2/14, together with the maker's instructions. This app does not assert an interval for this check — the source material it was built from does not state one. Take the interval from the vessel's maintenance plan, from MSC.1/Circ.1432 as amended, and from the maker's manual, and record the resulting date here.

flagOverrides.RMI: RMI: maintenance and inspection of fire-protection systems and appliances is covered by Marine Notice 2-011-14.
flagOverrides.LIB: Liberia: fire-protection systems and appliances are covered by Marine Notice FIR-001.
flagOverrides.PAN: Panama: the onboard maintenance plan must state which tasks are crew-performed (advanced fire-fighting trained) and which need specially trained persons (MMC-281); records may be paper or computer-based on board.
